headlines.title: Supreme Court temporarily allows Trump ballroom construction to continue
headlines.description: Supreme Court rules on whether Trump can move forward with construction on the White House ballroom.

headlines.title: Severe Storms and Tornadoes Unleash Damage Across US
headlines.description: Extreme weather battered parts of the United States with severe storms, flooding, tornadoes and even waterspouts. States of emergency were declared on Long Island and in Delaware, while Kentucky and Pennsylvania also reported severe tornado and wind damage. NBC’s Valerie Castro reports and TODAY’s Dylan Dreyer tracks the forecast.

headlines.title: Could Harry and Meghan's UK Move Signal End of Royal Rift?
headlines.description: After Prince Harry and Meghan Markle’s shocking decision to return to the United Kingdom, questions are swirling on what’s behind the unexpected move and if could finally end the royal rift between Harry and his family. NBC’s Daniele Hamamdjian reports for TODAY from Buckingham Palace.

headlines.title: Navy discusses renaming aircraft carrier after Trump instead of heroic Black sailor
headlines.description: The USS Doris Miller would be the first aircraft carrier named after a Black and an enlisted sailor. The decision to name the carrier after Miller was made during Trump’s first term.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Supreme Court temporarily allows Trump ballroom construction to continue
headlines.description: Supreme Court rules on whether Trump can move forward with construction on the White House ballroom.

headlines.title: Eye drops recalled over possible contamination, FDA reports
headlines.description: The FDA reported that bottles of Clear Eyes Maximum Itchy Eye Relief have been recalled over potential contamination.

headlines.title: Laken Snelling, whose infant was found dead in closet, pleads guilty to manslaughter
headlines.description: Former University of Kentucky student-athlete Laken Snelling pleaded guilty to first-degree manslaughter in the death of her infant son, whose body was found inside a trash bag in a closet.

headlines.title: Teen says ‘demons’ made him stab girlfriend, then his mom helped hide her body, police say
headlines.description: A Pennsylvania teenager told police “demons” prompted him to fatally stab his girlfriend, a college soccer player, before his mother helped him clean up the crime scene and move the victim’s body, authorities said Thursday.

headlines.title: Alfalfa sprouts linked to dozens of illnesses from 2 different bacteria
headlines.description: Health officials are warning consumers not to eat certain brands of alfalfa sprouts that have been linked to an unusual outbreak involving different disease-causing bacteria.

headlines.title: This is what you need (and need to do) to stay safe this hurricane season
headlines.description: I talked to a meteorologist to find the best way to prepare for hurricanes and what products you should have on hand.

headlines.title: The Garmin Instinct 3 is at its back at its Prime Day low — it’s $150 off
headlines.description: The latest Garmin Instinct 3 is at its lowest price ever at Amazon and Dick’s. It’s a rugged, outdoor fitness tracker with extra long battery life.
